answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 148617 Country: India Title: Is the wife allowed to give ghusl to her husband's dead body? I have heard that the husband becomes non-Mahram for his wife after his death. What does Shariah say in these matters? Question: Is the wife allowed to give ghusl to her husband's dead body? I have heard that the husband becomes non-Mahram for his wife after his death. What does Shariah say in these matters? Answer ID: 148617 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 622/588/M=5/1438) A wife can give her husband bath after his death. What you heard is incorrect. ويجوز للمرأة أن تغسل زوجها اذا لم يحدث بعد موته ما يوجب البينونة .... أما هو فلا يغسلها عندنا (هنديه 1/160) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
